# Source File

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SourceFile`](gmeow-SourceFile.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SourceFile>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)
